messages.subject: Office closure & summer party - save the date
messages.plaintextBody:
Everyone,

Two notices: (1) the office will close at 16:00 on Friday 27 March for essential electrical testing - please take laptops home. (2) Save the date - the firm summer party will be on Friday 26 June at the Drapers' Hall. Invitations to follow.

Facilities Team
